overview_description.description:
Breathe Technologies, Inc was founded in 2005 with the objective of empowering healthcare providers and patients with new, reliable and accessible respiratory therapies that optimize breathing and mobility. 
They are in the process of developing truly ultra-light, compact, patient-friendly ventilator systems that can transform respiratory care in the hospital and home markets.
